title: Nos omnes biberimus viridum toxicum diabolus capiat posterioria nostria
html_source:
We will all drink green poison [and] the devil take the hindmost.
Ulysses Annotated: Notes for James Joyce’s Ulysses
by Don Gifford
(1988) 446.

Absinthe is a green liquid.
